thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: elevated 5xx + latency observed in eu-west-1 affecting Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Pager: @jamie-sre. Metrics: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/AX-9821 :rotating_light:

jamie-sre: oncall here, looking. seeing ELB 502/504 spike and connection-queue growth on edge tier. p95 latency jumped 80ms -> ~520ms. starting live mitigation.

leo-eng: AWS Health shows a 'Regional API/Network degradation' in eu-west-1 (https://status.aws.amazon.com/incidents/XYZ). also seeing increased 5xx from our regional ELBs (targets healthy).

anya-customer-ops: customer-impact: multiple EU customers reporting timeouts for model calls. one active ticket from "AcmeAnalytics" with request_id=abc123 showing repeated 502s. tagging CS to churn list.

jamie-sre: quick triage: not a model runtime failure, upstream ELB/ALB is returning 502/504s and connection queues. probable third-party (AWS) surface. plan: 1) shift new Hosted API traffic away from eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1, 2) temporarily suspend routing to Dedicated eu-west-1 pools for non-enterprise traffic, 3) enable degraded-mode (shorter max tokens, quantized model) for traces still hitting eu-west-1, 4) post status page update. executing now. :wrench:

jamie-sre: running routing override

```
POST /internal/v1/routing/overrides
{"region":"eu-west-1","target":"eu-central-1","scope":"hosted","reason":"eu-west-1 ELB 5xx spike"}
```

leo-eng: saw the override, pushing a Dedicated pool suspend for non-SLA traffic: `PATCH /dedicated/pools/eu-west-1?action=suspend-non-sla` — applied. verifying backend counts.

jamie-sre: enabling degraded-mode rollout for eu-west-1 (quantized fallback) to reduce token pressure:

```
POST /deployments/rollout
{"model":"redwood-llama-1","variant":"q4f-degraded","scope":"region:eu-west-1","percent":100}
```

oncall-ops: pushed a temporary global rate-limit for anonymous keys from eu-west-1 to protect control plane: `rate-limit set region=eu-west-1 scope=anonymous 10r/s`

sam-product: drafting status page and support blurb. suggested wording: "We are mitigating elevated errors in eu-west-1 by routing traffic to eu-central-1 and applying temporary protections. Some requests may see increased latency."

jamie-sre: initial numbers after reroute: eu-west-1 5xx rate dropped from ~34% -> ~6% for hosted API in last 2 minutes. latency p95 reduced from 520ms -> 160ms. still seeing some retries from Dedicated pool metrics but trending down.

anya-customer-ops: posting to customers now (support/status). will escalate enterprise customers individually.

leo-eng: AWS says they're investigating an edge networking component in eu-west-1; no ETA. opened a support case (case# 987654).

jamie-sre: mitigation status: traffic rerouted, dedicated-suspend applied, degraded-model rollout active, rate-limits in place. continuing to monitor. handoff plan: keep monitoring 30m, then hand to morning shift for post-incident follow-up. looking for postmortem owner.

incident-bot: Incident status -> MITIGATED -> monitoring. Alert will remain open until metrics stable for 60m.

jamie-sre: assigning postmortem ownership to @jamie-sre, will coordinate timeline & RCA with infra and product. handing off to @leo-eng for overnight watch. please escalate if customer impact increases. :white_check_mark:

leo-eng: noted, will watch dashboards and AWS updates. pls drop any new customer reports into #support-urgent.

sam-product: status page posted and scheduled updates every 30m until resolved. :mega:

anya-customer-ops: closing the high-priority support ticket loop after notifying AcmeAnalytics of mitigation steps. they reported recovery post-reroute.

jamie-sre: final note before handoff: keep the overrides in place until AWS confirms region healthy AND our 5xx < 1% for 60m. removing overrides will be a coordinated step.
